title: Nutty Noodle Vietnamese Chicken Pho
description: A kid-friendly, Vietnamese-inspired dish featuring a rich, jammy sauce, crispy noodles, and a sweet and sticky glaze.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated carrot to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the grated ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breast to the pan and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
In the same pan, add the chicken broth, fish sauce, and soy sauce. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the liquid cheese to the pan and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss to coat with the sauce.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss to coat with the sauce.
In a small bowl, mix together the sugar and cornstarch until well combined.
Add the sugar and cornstarch mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the noodles are well coated.
